mapper.select: SELECT p.product_img, p.product_Registration_status, p.product_info, p.product_status, p.product_id, p.product_cod, p.product_name, p.product_group, p.product_file_path, p.file_category, p.file_name, h.old_price, h.new_price, h.changed_at FROM product p INNER JOIN product_price_history h ON p.product_id = h.product_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MAX(changed_at) AS max_changed_at FROM product_price_history GROUP BY product_id ) latest ON h.product_id = latest.product_id AND h.changed_at = latest.max_changed_at WHERE p. product_status = '판매' AND p.product_group = #{product_group} AND h.old_price != h.new_price ORDER BY p.product_id;
